task.title: P6-060: Build a hydration-aware click helper for e2e streamed islands
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 3 — Leverage: fixes that retire a whole class). Original id: P6-060. Size: M. Specs: specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**Build a hydration-aware click helper — `hydrated(page)` does not imply a streamed island is interactive, and four tests flake on it.** `hydrated()` waits on the global `<html data-hydrated>` stamp (`end2end/helpers.ts:15-17`), which says the document hydrated, not that a *streamed* Suspense island's controls are wired up. Under worker pressure the click lands before the island is live, is swallowed, and the test times out. Confirmed across `smoke.spec.ts:92` and `:114`, `collection-tree.spec.ts:65`, `selection-tray.spec.ts:239`: a different subset fails each run at the default worker count, every one passes in isolation, `--workers=1` gives a clean 143/143. The `--workers=1` mitigation is already recorded in the `e2e-suite` skill (`:100-110`) with matching numbers; **no per-island helper has been built**. Spans three spec files and is a suite-wide policy choice, which is why it is filed rather than patched.
